An O3 frontend module declares its config schema by calling `defineConfigSchema(moduleName, schema)` from its `index.ts` startup function. The call registers the schema in the config system's internal store. Implementers can then override the settings through their config files. I didn't open the linked o3-docs page or the chart's schema files. The `index.ts` locations for the chart's `defineConfigSchema` calls come from search hits, and I read only the core implementation itself.

**Implementation**
- `defineConfigSchema` in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts` (lines 357–378) validates the schema and merges it with the implicit schema. It stores the result in `configInternalStore` under `schemas[moduleName]` and marks the module as loaded. Its doc comment links to https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/configuration-system.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/public.ts` (line 4) exports it, along with `defineExtensionConfigSchema`, `provide` and `getConfig`.
